name: Gadget Repair Shop
mechanic: A broken gadget (toaster, robot, music box) buzzes on the workbench with one glowing empty socket showing an equation like 8 + ? = 13. The child computes the missing addend and drags the matching cog/part with that number into the socket; the gadget whirs back to life.
why_distinct: Closest neighbor is magic-machine (input→output transformation). Separation: magic-machine produces something NEW from an input; here the gadget is BROKEN and the child must DIAGNOSE the missing value to RESTORE it — the equation is a fault, not a transformation rule, and the payoff is 'fixed/working' not 'created'.
fun_no_competition: The dead gadget sputters, then lights up and does its silly job (toaster pops bread, robot dances). Gratitude animation: 'You fixed me! Thank you!'
interaction: drag part into socket; tap to test
character_world: Fixit the friendly repair-mole runs a cozy basement repair shop full of personality-rich broken gadgets
web_shell_feasibility: feasible — DOM gadget sprite + CSS socket-glow, drag numbered parts, sprite-swap to 'working' state
asset_idea: stub: gray boxy gadget + empty socket rectangle. CA5: 6-8 gadget characters each in broken (dim, loose part) + repaired (bright, animated) sprite pairs; numbered cog/gear parts

name: Word Doctor's Clinic
mechanic: A 'sick' word lies on the exam cot misspelled (e.g. 'rabbt', 'becuase'). The child taps the wrong/missing letter spot — the X-ray highlights it — then drags the correct letter from the medicine tray to heal it. The word's fever-meter cools to green when spelled right.
why_distinct: Closest neighbor is magic-trace (forming letters). Separation: magic-trace is about MOTOR letter formation; here the letters already exist and the skill is DIAGNOSING which letter is wrong/missing and replacing it (orthographic error-detection), not handwriting.
fun_no_competition: The word sweats, sniffles, then beams healthy once fixed. Doctor's badge 'All better!' and the patient word hops off the cot saying its name aloud.
interaction: tap to diagnose spot, drag correct letter
character_world: A gentle word-clinic where words are wobbly patients and the child is the caring word-doctor with a stethoscope
web_shell_feasibility: feasible — letter tiles in DOM, highlight class on tapped spot, TTS pronounces the healed word
asset_idea: stub: plain letter-tile word on a cot rectangle. CA5: exam-room background, fever-meter, medicine tray of letters, sick→healthy word face overlays

name: Quilt Mender
mechanic: A patchwork quilt has a torn hole shaped like a missing patch. Surrounding patches show a number-bond / part-whole relationship (e.g. a row totals 10, one patch is blank). The child computes the missing patch value and stitches in the correct numbered fabric square to make the quilt whole.
why_distinct: Closest neighbor is reveal-grid (uncovering tiles) and sort-home. Separation: reveal-grid hides content to be uncovered; here the grid is a SPATIAL whole with a literal HOLE, and the missing value is constrained by the patches AROUND it (row/whole relationships), making it a part-whole repair, not an uncover or a sort.
fun_no_competition: The stitched patch zips in with a satisfying thread animation; the quilt smooths flat and a cozy 'warm and whole again' shimmer runs across it.
character_world: Granny Stitch's cozy sewing nook; quilts have names and want to keep a teddy warm
web_shell_feasibility: feasible — CSS grid of patch tiles, one transparent hole cell, drag-snap numbered square
asset_idea: stub: colored grid with one empty cell. CA5: textured fabric patches with numbers, torn-edge hole, stitch-zip sparkle, smiling quilt

name: Sentence Surgeon
mechanic: An ungrammatical sentence lies on the operating table ('she walk to school', 'the dog are big'). The child taps the faulty word, then drags the corrected form from the tool tray (walk→walks, are→is). A heart-monitor blips healthy when the sentence is grammatically sound.
why_distinct: Closest neighbor is story-maker (assembling sentences) and word-doctor (#02 spelling). Separation: story-maker builds from scratch; word-doctor fixes spelling within a single word; this is GRAMMAR/conventions error-correction across a whole sentence (subject-verb agreement, tense), a syntactic diagnosis not an orthographic or compositional one.
fun_no_competition: Flatline-to-heartbeat audio when fixed, the sentence sits up on the table smiling and reads itself aloud correctly via TTS.
interaction: tap faulty word, drag corrected form
character_world: A friendly cartoon operating room where sentences are patients with bandages over the broken word
web_shell_feasibility: feasible — tokenized sentence in DOM, tap-to-select token, swap word, TTS read-back
asset_idea: stub: sentence tokens on a table line + tray of word chips. CA5: surgeon mole, heart-monitor strip, bandaged sentence patient, tool-tray of replacement words

name: Clockwork Fixer
mechanic: A wonky tower clock shows wrong/missing hands or a frozen face. The child reads a target time ('soccer practice at 3:30') and drags the hour and minute hands to the correct positions to repair the clock. The clock ticks again and chimes when set right.
why_distinct: Closest neighbor is grow-tend (nurturing over time) and path-journey. Separation: those are about progression/time passing; here the skill is reading and SETTING analog clock hands to repair a literally-broken clock — a telling-time instantiation framed as fixing a frozen mechanism, not tending or traveling.
fun_no_competition: The stuck clock shudders, then bursts into happy ticking with a little cuckoo bird that pops out chirping 'Right on time, thank you!'
character_world: A whimsical clock-tower town where every clock is a sleepy character that overslept because it's broken
web_shell_feasibility: feasible — SVG clock face, atan2 angle-snap drag on hands (proven E10 clock-core pattern)
asset_idea: stub: SVG circle with two draggable line-hands. CA5: ornate clock-tower face with eyes, cuckoo bird, gear background, repaired-glow

name: Recipe Rescue
mechanic: A recipe card is smudged with a WRONG quantity (says '7 eggs' but the cake needs the number that makes the equation true, e.g. 3 + ? = 6 worth of ingredient). The child crosses out the wrong number and stamps in the correct quantity. The bowl mixes and the cake bakes right.
why_distinct: Closest neighbor is feed-the-friend and magic-machine. Separation: feed-the-friend is matching/giving; magic-machine transforms. Here a value is explicitly WRONG and must be detected and corrected against a constraint — error-correction of a quantity, with the 'wrong vs right' diagnosis being the skill, not feeding or transforming.
fun_no_competition: With the right amount, the mixer swirls happily and a perfect cake rises with a 'ding!'; the wrong amount earlier made a comically lopsided cake the child gets to un-do.
interaction: tap wrong number, stamp correct number
character_world: Chef Pip's bakery kitchen where recipes get splattered and need a quantity-detective to rescue dinner
web_shell_feasibility: feasible — recipe card DOM with editable number slot, number stamp tray, CSS bake animation
asset_idea: stub: recipe card with a number field + number buttons. CA5: bakery kitchen, smudged recipe card, mixing bowl, lopsided→perfect cake pair

name: Number-Line Track Repair
mechanic: A railway/number-line has missing or fallen tick-mark stations between two known numbers. The child drags numbered ties into the gaps so the sequence is correct and evenly spaced, repairing the track so the train can roll across.
why_distinct: Closest neighbor is path-journey (moving along a path). Separation: path-journey is about traversal/progress; here nothing moves until the child RECONSTRUCTS the missing structure of the line itself — placing missing numbers in sequence/skip-count, a number-line completion repair, not a journey.
fun_no_competition: Each correct tie clicks into place with a satisfying clack; when the gap is whole, a cheery train chugs across the repaired track waving.
character_world: A toy-train valley where a friendly engine is stuck because storm-damaged track needs a track-repair crew
web_shell_feasibility: feasible — horizontal DOM line with gap slots, drag numbered ties, CSS train traversal on completion
asset_idea: stub: horizontal line with empty notch slots + numbered tie buttons. CA5: railway ties, wooden train engine character, storm-debris, repaired-track sparkle

name: Faded Sign Restorer
mechanic: A weathered shop/street sign has letters faded to ghosts. The child reads context clues and the surviving letters, then taps to restore each missing letter (chosen from a palette) to spell the real word, painting the sign vivid again.
why_distinct: Closest neighbor is word-doctor (#02). Separation: word-doctor fixes a WRONG letter (substitution diagnosis); here letters are MISSING/faded and the skill is using phonics + visible partial letters to reconstruct the intended word (cloze decoding), a restoration of absent information, not correction of a present error.
fun_no_competition: Each restored letter blooms back into full color with a paintbrush stroke; the finished sign lights up neon and the shopkeeper cheers that customers can find them again.
interaction: tap faded slot, choose letter from palette
character_world: A cozy old-town main street where shopkeeper animals can't get customers because their signs faded
web_shell_feasibility: feasible — sign DOM with faded-letter slots (low-opacity), letter palette, opacity/color transition on fill
asset_idea: stub: word with some letters dimmed + letter buttons. CA5: wooden/neon shop signs, weathered texture, paintbrush, shopkeeper animals, lit-up restored state

name: Pipe Leak Patch
mechanic: A burst plumbing pipe sprays where a section is missing; the visible flow is labeled with a comparison/equation gap (e.g. left pipe pushes 5, right needs to match — drag the > = < valve or the number that balances). The child patches the correct piece so flow balances and the leak stops.
why_distinct: Closest neighbor is sort-home and pop-the-right-ones. Separation: those select/route items; here the child evaluates a relational constraint (equality/comparison) to choose the ONE patch that makes a broken system balance — comparison/equality as the diagnostic, with water-physics feedback, not selection or popping.
fun_no_competition: The right patch snaps in, the spray shrinks to a sealed drip, then the pipe gurgles happily and water flows to fill a fish's tank — the fish thanks you.
interaction: drag patch/valve into the leak gap
character_world: Plumber-otter's underground waterworks; a thirsty fish friend depends on the pipe being fixed
web_shell_feasibility: feasible — DOM pipe segments, spray particle CSS, drag patch, balance check toggles flow animation
asset_idea: stub: pipe with a gap + spray + patch buttons. CA5: waterworks tunnel, otter plumber, spray particles, numbered/valve patches, grateful fish in tank

name: Pattern Weaver's Loom
mechanic: A weaving on the loom has a chewed-out gap mid-pattern (ABBABB...). The child reads the repeating unit from the intact threads and drags the correct colored/shaped threads into the gap to continue the pattern and restore the cloth.
why_distinct: Closest neighbor is build-a-world and dress-decorate. Separation: those are open creative placement; here the placement is CONSTRAINED — the child must infer the repeating rule from the surviving pattern and supply EXACTLY the missing elements to restore continuity, a pattern-completion repair, not free decoration.
fun_no_competition: Each correct thread weaves in with a shuttle-clack; when the gap is closed the whole cloth ripples and unfurls into a beautiful scarf the loom-spider proudly wears.
character_world: A kindly loom-spider artisan whose masterpiece scarf got nibbled by moths
web_shell_feasibility: feasible — DOM row of pattern cells with empty gap cells, drag colored/shaped threads, ripple CSS on completion
asset_idea: stub: colored cell row with blank gaps + colored thread buttons. CA5: wooden loom, spider weaver, thread spools, moth-hole, unfurling scarf

name: Bridge Engineer
mechanic: A stone bridge is missing a keystone block; the surrounding blocks show an addition/subtraction equation that the missing block must satisfy (e.g. the arch reads 14 - ? = 6). The child computes it and lowers the correctly-numbered keystone by crane; the bridge holds and traffic crosses.
why_distinct: Closest neighbor is Gadget Repair Shop (#01) and Quilt Mender (#03). Separation vs #01: #01 is a single socket in a gadget; here the missing piece is STRUCTURAL — it must bear weight, and the equation tension is subtraction-within-20 read across an arch. Separation vs #03: #03 is part-whole within a flat row; here it's a single load-bearing keystone with a 'will it hold?' test/payoff (a structural stress-test, not stitching).
fun_no_competition: The crane lowers the keystone; the bridge settles with a solid thunk and a 'will-it-hold?' wobble that resolves to steady. A parade of animals safely crosses, waving.
interaction: tap to compute, crane lowers numbered keystone
character_world: Beaver Construction Co. where a washed-out bridge strands a line of animals who need to get home
web_shell_feasibility: feasible — DOM arch of blocks with one gap, number choice lowers block, CSS settle/wobble + crossing animation
asset_idea: stub: arch of numbered blocks with a gap + number buttons. CA5: stone bridge, crane, beaver foreman, numbered keystones, waiting animal parade

name: Torn Picture Mender
mechanic: A photo/storybook page is ripped so part of the SENTENCE caption and image are torn away. The child reads the surviving sentence and chooses the word that correctly completes the meaning (context/comprehension cloze), taping the torn strip back so the picture and caption reunite.
why_distinct: Closest neighbor is Faded Sign (#08) and story-maker. Separation vs #08: #08 restores LETTERS within a known word via phonics; here the missing piece is a whole WORD chosen for meaning/context (comprehension/vocabulary cloze), not decoding. Separation vs story-maker: not free composition — exactly one word fits the existing sentence's sense.
fun_no_competition: The torn strip floats back and tapes shut with a gentle seam-heal; the reunited picture animates (the now-complete scene comes alive) and the caption reads aloud whole.
interaction: drag/tap correct word-strip into the tear
character_world: Granny's photo album / a storybook elf who repairs beloved torn pages so families can remember
web_shell_feasibility: feasible — DOM page with a torn-gap word slot, word-strip choices, CSS seam-mend, TTS read-back
asset_idea: stub: sentence with a blank + word-strip buttons over a picture. CA5: ripped-paper texture, photo-album scene halves, tape seam, storybook elf, reunited animated scene

name: Scale Balance Mechanic
mechanic: A broken balance-scale tips because one pan is wrong. The child reads both pans (e.g. left = 3 + 4, right = ?) and drags the correct weight onto the empty/wrong pan to make both sides EQUAL, leveling the scale and fixing the shop's measuring station.
why_distinct: Closest neighbor is Pipe Leak (#09) and Recipe Rescue (#06). Separation vs #09: #09 is flow/comparison with water feedback and choosing among valves; here it's literal physical EQUALITY of two computed expressions with a tilting-scale model (the meaning of the equal sign, 1.OA.D.7). Separation vs #06: not a wrong-quantity inside a recipe but a two-sided balance whose physical tilt IS the feedback.
fun_no_competition: As the correct weight lands, the scale wobbles and slowly levels with a satisfying 'tink-tink-balance' chime; a level bubble centers and the shopkeeper can weigh fruit again.
character_world: A market grocer-badger whose old balance scale broke, so nobody can buy apples until it's level again
web_shell_feasibility: feasible — DOM scale with rotating beam (CSS transform driven by pan difference), drag numbered weights
asset_idea: stub: two pans on a tilting beam + weight buttons. CA5: market stall, badger grocer, brass scale, numbered weights, level-bubble, fruit

name: Punctuation Electrician
mechanic: A sentence's lights are out because the end punctuation/capital is broken or missing (no capital, missing period/question mark). The child rewires by tapping where it's wrong and choosing the correct mark/capital from the toolbox; the sentence's bulbs light up when conventions are correct.
why_distinct: Closest neighbor is Sentence Surgeon (#04) and Word Doctor (#02). Separation vs #04: #04 fixes grammar (agreement/tense — the words themselves); here the words are fine but the MECHANICS (capitalization + end punctuation) are broken — a distinct conventions sub-skill with an electrical 'circuit complete' framing. Separation vs #02: not letters within a word but sentence-level marks.
fun_no_competition: Each correct fix sparks a wire; when all conventions are right the whole sentence sign buzzes alight with a warm glow and a cheerful 'lights on!' the town can read at night.
interaction: tap broken spot, select mark/capital from toolbox
character_world: Sparky the electrician-raccoon who fixes the town's word-marquee so it shines at night
web_shell_feasibility: feasible — DOM sentence with tappable capital + end-mark slots, mark toolbox, CSS glow on correct
asset_idea: stub: sentence with a capital slot + end-mark slot + mark buttons. CA5: marquee sign with bulbs, raccoon electrician, toolbox of punctuation, lit-up glow

name: Ten-Frame Tile Restorer
mechanic: A mosaic/wall is broken with chunks missing; the design encodes a teen number as tens-and-ones (a full ten-frame plus loose tiles). The child reads the number ('repair to show 14') and fills the missing tens-block and ones-tiles into the wall to restore the picture, building place-value as restoration.
why_distinct: Closest neighbor is reveal-grid and Quilt Mender (#03). Separation vs reveal-grid: nothing is hidden-to-uncover; tiles are MISSING and must be supplied per a place-value target. Separation vs #03: #03 fills a single value from a part-whole row; here the child composes tens+ones (1.NBT place value) into a mosaic — a base-ten composition repair, distinct number concept and structure.
fun_no_competition: Each tile clicks in restoring the picture; when the number is whole the mosaic shimmers into a finished mural and the mosaic-artist snail beams 'You restored my masterpiece!'
interaction: drag ten-block + ones-tiles into wall gaps
character_world: A snail mosaic-artist whose tile mural cracked and needs a careful tile-restorer's hands
web_shell_feasibility: feasible — DOM ten-frame block + ones cells with empty slots, drag tiles, CSS reveal of underlying mural
asset_idea: stub: ten-frame grid + ones row with empty cells + tile buttons. CA5: cracked mosaic wall, snail artist, ten-block + single-tile sprites, finished mural reveal

name: Vet's Diagnosis Window
mechanic: A poorly animal arrives with symptoms shown as a quantity story (e.g. 'ate 12 berries, threw up 5 — how many left in the tummy x-ray?'). The child reads the word-problem, solves it, and dials the correct number into the x-ray machine to diagnose and heal the patient.
why_distinct: Closest neighbor is Word Doctor (#02, a clinic) and Recipe Rescue (#06). Separation vs #02: #02 heals SPELLING; this heals via solving a WORD-PROBLEM (math story → take-away/add-to result, 1.OA.A.1) with a diagnosis dial. Separation vs #06: not detecting a wrong quantity but generating the answer to a contextual story to cure a patient.
fun_no_competition: The right diagnosis dials in, the x-ray glows the answer, and the patient is bandaged, hops up healthy, and nuzzles you with a 'Thank you, doctor!' sticker for the wall.
interaction: read story, dial/tap the result number
character_world: A warm woodland vet clinic where shy animal patients trust the child-vet to figure out what they need
web_shell_feasibility: feasible — DOM story card + number dial/keypad + x-ray panel, sprite swap to healed patient
asset_idea: stub: story text + number keypad + result window. CA5: cozy vet room, sick→healed animal patient pairs, x-ray machine, bandages, gratitude stickers
